Deadline 1,200 s: 20 steps x (the 20 s pacing interval + a 40 s per-call allowance, ~4x this route's observed per-call latency; runs 3-4 ran 12 iterations in ~240-290 s) = 1,200 s. The deadline remains the one authoritative clock; a single call may still lawfully take its 300 s adapter span within it. Grant counts stand as commissioned (exec 12, retrieval 12 per tool and prefix, write 4): they do not bind the honest or the ranged path, so the re-derivation leaves them.
